rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for leaving someone far behind in a race or other comparison.

example.english: Our team has to outdistance the opponents on the final lap to have a chance of winning the championship.
example.traditional: 我哋隊要喺最後一圈拋離對手，先至有機會攞冠軍。
